links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy, comprehensiveness and safety, and error rate, for soft tissue sarcoma queries
links.effect: RAG outperformed non-RAG across all evaluated areas (p < 0.05); error rate 40% without RAG reduced to 10% with RAG
links.tradeoff: The model still produced incorrect responses in certain complex scenarios, and caution is advised in clinical use, particularly for rare diseases like sarcoma.
links.quote: GPT-4o with RAG outperformed the model without RAG across all evaluated areas (p < 0.05).
